post.description: Makes the signed-in user follow another user. Body: authToken, user (the user to follow). Returns that user's new followerCount and followeeCount.
Returns how many users a user is following. Body: authToken, user. Returns count.
Returns how many users follow a user. Body: authToken, user. Returns count.
Looks up a user by alias. Body: authToken, alias. Returns the user, or null when no user has that alias.
Checks whether one user follows another. Body: authToken, user, selectedUser. Returns isFollower, which is true when user follows selectedUser.

Returns one page of a user's feed, the statuses posted by the users they follow. Body: authToken, userAlias, pageSize, lastItem (the last status on the previous page, or null for the first page). Returns items (statuses) and hasMore.
Returns one page of the users a user is following. Body: authToken, userAlias, pageSize, lastItem (the last user on the previous page, or null for the first page). Returns items (users) and hasMore.
Returns one page of the users who follow a user. Body: authToken, userAlias, pageSize, lastItem (the last user on the previous page, or null for the first page). Returns items (users) and hasMore.

Returns one page of a user's story, the statuses they posted. Body: authToken, userAlias, pageSize, lastItem (the last status on the previous page, or null for the first page). Returns items (statuses) and hasMore.
Signs a user in. Body: alias, password. Returns the user and a new auth token.
Signs a user out. Body: authToken. Ends the session for that token.
Posts a new status for the signed-in user. Body: authToken, newStatus (post text, user, timestamp).

Creates a new user and signs them in. Body: firstName, lastName, alias, password, userImageBase64 (profile image bytes as base64), imageFileExtension (e.g. "png"). Returns the new user and an auth token.
Makes the signed-in user stop following another user. Body: authToken, user (the user to unfollow). Returns that user's new followerCount and followeeCount.

properties.description: Tweeter API. Every endpoint is a POST that takes a JSON body and returns a JSON body with success and message, plus the endpoint's own fields. Endpoints other than login and register need the authToken from login or register in the body. Errors return 400 (bad request) or 500 (server error) with an errorMessage.
